temporal_state_chain.observed: Ethan notices Gary has been working excessively long hours at the hospital, skipping meals, and sacrificing sleep. Ethan invites Gary to a weekend retreat, but Gary declines, saying there is too much to do at the hospital.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan believes Gary is a dedicated friend and hardworking hospital professional, but he has not yet fully understood how serious Gary's overwork has become or why Gary cannot step away.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; the event strengthens his concern and shows that Gary's overwork is severe and that Gary feels unable to take even a short break due to hospital obligations.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Gary is seriously overworked and at risk, and he currently believes he cannot leave his hospital responsibilities; he needs help finding balance but is resistant or constrained.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Concerned, worried, and possibly frustrated that Gary will not accept help.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To intervene supportively, encourage Gary to rest, and look for ways to help him recognize the need for a healthier balance.

temporal_state_chain.observed: At the retreat, Ethan observes Gary acting restless and avoiding discussions about work. When Ethan confronts him gently, Gary says it is complicated and that he did not want to burden Ethan with his problems.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan believes Gary is severely overworked due mainly to hospital demands and needs rest, but he is now noticing that Gary seems uneasy even away from work.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; his suspicion shifts from purely professional overwork to the possibility of deeper personal or emotional problems Gary is hiding.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Gary is dealing with something more than ordinary work stress; he is reluctant to share it because he does not want to burden Ethan, but he may open up with nonjudgmental support.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Suspicious, concerned, and empathetic; perhaps worried about what Gary is hiding.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To gently confront Gary, reassure him that he can speak freely, and encourage him to open up so Ethan can help.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Gary opens up about the pressures of managing a new department and personal challenges he is facing. Gary agrees that Ethan's suggestion to prioritize tasks and delegate could help him organize his schedule and make time for himself.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan believes Gary has deeper problems beyond work and is hiding burdens, but he does not yet know the specific causes or whether Gary will accept help.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; the event confirms that Gary's overwork is driven by a combination of new departmental pressures and personal challenges, and it shows Gary is willing to accept support.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Gary's situation is complex but understandable; with practical help such as prioritization and delegation, Gary can begin to find a healthier balance.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Relief mixed with empathy, compassion, and cautious hope.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To help Gary prioritize tasks, delegate responsibilities, organize his schedule, and find better work-life balance.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Over the following months, Ethan regularly checks in with Gary. Gary reports progress and challenges; he says things are better, he is less overwhelmed, and he even had time for a movie last weekend.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan believes Gary can improve with support and practical planning, though Gary still faces challenges and needs encouragement.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Gary's reported progress and concrete sign of leisure time confirm that the changes are working and that Gary is actively making efforts.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Gary is improving, less overwhelmed, and capable of making time for himself; continued support and encouragement are helping him sustain progress.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To continue regular check-ins, offer encouragement, and remain available to talk while Gary works on maintaining balance.

temporal_state_chain.observed: After a year, Ethan sees that Gary has successfully adjusted to a healthier work-life balance. Gary says he feels more in control and thanks Ethan, saying he could not have done it without his support.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan believes Gary has been improving with support, but he may still need check-ins and encouragement to maintain balance.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Gary's sustained adjustment and sense of control confirm that Gary can now manage independently.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Gary has achieved a healthier balance and can manage on his own; Ethan's active support role is no longer needed, though he can remain available.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Satisfied, happy for Gary, proud, and relieved.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To step back and let Gary manage independently, while letting Gary know he is always available if needed.
